newsitem.title: GERMANY: German electricity firms ready for liberalisation.
newsitem.headline: German electricity firms ready for liberalisation.

text.p: Management at nearly 90 percent of Germany's electricity producers said they were prepared for the liberalisation of the European electricity market, said a report by auditors Price Waterhouse on Monday.

German electricity producers were more confident than their European counterparts. Of the 400 high-ranking managers in 11 European countries surveyed, 60 percent were happy with EU guidelines for domestic electricity markets, the report said.
The new EU guidelines are aimed at freeing up the 250-billion-mark market for European energy production, transport and distribution.
The majority of managers thought the opportunities were higher than the risks involved. Around 44 percent of those surveyed expected competition for specialised customers to be particularly hard.
In particular Belgian, Danish and Italian companies were fearful of foreign competition, while German companies expected competition to come from the domestic market.
